head: codex/5627-csdlc-four-command-lifecycle
title: fix(csdlc-v2): collapse routine lifecycle into four commands
body:
Closes #5627

Collapses the normal post-implementation lifecycle into finalize, review, publish, and closeout. CI no longer nests owner-binary Cargo builds: Gate 10A reuses Cargo-built artifacts, while explicit installation reuses a verified current installation and otherwise performs one locked build.
